integrity: Algebraic proof; finite independent monomial consistency checks; older foundational methods and normalized fan are credited.
scientific_limitations: First ordinary Nash blowup only, codimension-one generic exceptional point; excludes characteristic two, closed-fibre stratification and iterated blowups; earlier general toric constructions exist; no independent confirmation of exact novelty.
title: A one-step wild conductor jump in ordinary Nash modifications of odd \(A\)-type surface singularities
